name: SPICE
brief: Drug-like molecules from PubChem, dipeptides and solvated amino acids, non-covalent dimers, and monatomic ion pairs, computed at the ωB97M-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVPPD level. Assembled by the Open Force Field Initiative to train potentials for drug-like molecules interacting with proteins.
elements: 15 (H, C, N, O, F, P, S, Cl, Br, I + Li, Na, Mg, K, Ca)
paperTitle: SPICE, A Dataset of Drug-like Molecules and Peptides for Training Machine Learning Potentials
primaryPaper: Eastman et al., SPICE: A Dataset for Training Machine Learning Potentials, Sci. Data 10:11 (2023).
